artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: git blob d823581045afdef22316e7d636f5d4b15779e548 (worktree wk-IRPT_BCKEND-74, committed below). calculate() no longer refuses everything but 49F: firm = scope['verified_request_firm_id']; canonical_firm = _canonical_firm_for(firm) (new helper, tenants.route_for + a reverse of tenants._LEGACY_SHORT_ID back to the registry's canonical firm id, refusing an unrouted firm as HoldingsGoldRefused). bind_report_currency(tenants._CANONICAL_49F) -> bind_report_currency(canonical_firm). map_account gained a required firm parameter and is now this module's OWN implementation of f49_engine.map_account's rule (ids.opaque_account(firm, raw) matched against source.account_keys(day)) instead of delegating to f49_engine.map_account, which hardcodes 49 Financial and cannot serve a second firm.

git blob d688170ea1886bf451ff742680b13d6beef44515 (worktree wk-IRPT_BCKEND-74). RetainedPerformance.__init__ gains holdings_sources (dict, canonical firm id -> HoldingsGoldSource); holdings_source= (round-20 spelling) stays accepted as a plain attribute, and the new _holdings_source_for(firm_id) method reconciles the two (49F's plain attribute takes precedence when set, so an existing caller mutating service.holdings_source = ... after construction still lands on the same read _compute uses). The composed-firm gate (_compute) now requires holdings_firm (owner firm_id resolved through _holdings_source_for) for BOTH engine_firm (49F) and inf_firm (Inflection) -- no fallback to f49_engine or orion_selected for either. accepted_key['basis'], the fresh-path implausible-series guard (IB-pr-214) and the reopen-side implausible-series guard are all keyed on holdings_firm instead of engine_firm alone, so Inflection gets the same pre-switch-pointer isolation and the same fresh-path guard 49F already had. _provider/orion_selected/_inf_mapping_loader stay importable (row IRPT_BCKEND-W74-S1) but the fresh-path else-branch (vendor path) is reached only when NOT holdings_firm, which for Inflection now only happens when its registry address fails to resolve.

git blob d7e8235f4fd37e3e68f883bd2dda584d2bd38f9f (worktree wk-IRPT_BCKEND-74). _holdings_source(s3) (49F only) split into _holdings_source_for(s3, canonical_firm) (one firm's port, address resolved via opal_naming.address('irpt', canonical_firm, ...), None on a ValueError) and _holdings_sources(s3) (both tenants._CANONICAL_49F and tenants._CANONICAL_INF, each resolved independently -- a registry refusal for one never blocks the other, mirroring the pre-existing 49F-alone resilience rule). Iterates over the canonical firm ids themselves (the registry's own firm token) rather than a hand-typed '49financial'/'inflection' string -- the naming gate's LGIC_ENFORCE limb refused the hand-typed 'inflection' literal on the first attempt (NAMING REFUSE, NEW hand-kept carrier); fixed by reading the token from tenants._CANONICAL_INF instead. build_runtime now passes holdings_sources=_holdings_sources(s3) instead of holdings_source=_holdings_source(s3); _inf_mapping_loader(...) is still built and passed as inf_mapping_loader= for backward compatibility (unused on the served path once Inflection's holdings source composes, per retained.py's change above) so the out-of-grant structural test tests/test_inf_packaging.py keeps passing unedited.

git blob b980c10332d5ffbb2a2e19aad54d40b0741d7fb7 (worktree wk-IRPT_BCKEND-74). test_another_firm_never_reads_the_holdings_gold (asserted zero S3 reads for a wrong-firm scope, a guarantee the firm-generalized calculate() no longer makes -- it now attempts the account mapping before refusing) replaced with test_an_account_minted_under_a_different_firm_never_matches_this_gold (same two firms, COT/INF, proves the refusal via the account-mapping namespace mismatch instead). test_the_account_mapping_reuses_the_engine_lanes_own_rule replaced with test_the_account_mapping_reuses_the_engine_lanes_rule_parameterized_on_firm (map_account's new required firm argument, plus a same-raw-key-different-firm-namespace negative case). Added test_an_unrouted_firm_refuses_by_name and test_inflection_answers_from_its_own_gold_with_its_own_currency_binding (Inflection's own scope/gold/currency attestation, mirroring the 49F YTD test's shape). `python -m pytest tests/test_holdings_gold.py -q` -> 14 passed.

git blob b200781245a182c0c3741c4dca60a94614065918 (worktree wk-IRPT_BCKEND-74). test_inflection_is_computed_on_orion_retained_and_reopened_without_a_second_call (asserted lineage.provider == 'ORION' for Inflection, the behaviour ruling 12 retires) replaced with test_inflection_is_computed_from_the_holdings_gold_retained_and_reopened_without_a_second_read (mirrors the existing 49F holdings test: Inflection's own in-memory gold, load_mapping/transport_factory/inf_mapping_loader all poisoned to prove none is reached, provider == OPAL_HOLDINGS, no second S3 read on reopen). test_inflection_without_its_mapping_port_stays_uncomposed renamed test_inflection_without_its_holdings_source_stays_uncomposed (same assertion, ProviderPathNotComposed, now the correct reason under the new gate). `python -m pytest tests/test_retained_performance.py -q` -> 20 passed; full package `python -m pytest tests/ -q` -> 228 passed, 2 warnings (pre-existing pandas FutureWarning, unrelated).
